en.title: G.S.Y.H.S
en.decryption: Key rulers in order/importance. Remember: Simuka (Founder), Hala (Gathasaptashati), Gautamiputra (Restorer).

hi.title: G.S.Y.H.S
hi.decryption: Key rulers in order/importance. Remember: Simuka (Founder), Hala (Gathasaptashati), Gautamiputra (Restorer).

fact.en: Confusing 'Matronymics' with Matriarchy; Satavahanas were patriarchal but respected queens.
fact.hi: Confusing 'Matronymics' with Matriarchy; Satavahanas were patriarchal but respected queens.

fact.en: Assuming they were purely agrarian; they were masters of maritime trade via western ports.
fact.hi: Assuming they were purely agrarian; they were masters of maritime trade via western ports.

fact.en: Mistaking 'Gathasaptashati' for a religious text; it is secular Prakrit literature.
fact.hi: Mistaking 'Gathasaptashati' for a religious text; it is secular Prakrit literature.
